aiChanges: Alive passengers count toward attack waves and army limits.
Transport loss memory expires and is checked on planned and active routes.
Accessible transport purchases precede aircraft savings.
Pickup reservations preserve meetings and release on failures; urgent defense stays active.
Turn-based loading respects actions; commanders, capture and airport workers are excluded.
Partial unloading keeps the remaining delivery destination.
Unloaded red helicopters can bombard in range and seek maintenance; cargo and pickup take priority.
